remarks: The seller is asking for the Best and Final offers by Sunday 3/29 at 7:00pm. A Westport classic cape, at an attractive price! Blending timeless charm with modern enhancements, this home is truly move-in ready while still offering room for your personal touch. Inside, the main level features an open kitchen with breakfast bar that opens to a living room with wood-burning fireplace. The family room, with its vaulted ceiling and skylights, opens directly to a private, fully fenced yard with a stone patio-perfect for entertaining or quiet relaxation. Adjacent to the family room is a flexible space with a dry bar, ideal for a formal dining area or a home office. A bedroom and full bath on the main floor offer a private guest suite or the option for a main-floor primary bedroom. Upstairs, you'll find two additional bedrooms including the primary bedroom and full bath. The spacious primary bedroom is a true retreat, designed with both comfort and style in mind. Sunlight streams through large windows, creating a bright and airy atmosphere that invites you to relax and unwind. The lower level offers finished bonus space ideal for a play/rec room or home office, along a with a laundry area and storage space. Additional perks include sewer availability on the street, and an approved variance for a two-car garage.
